name: House Call
summary: One continuous shot from his seat in a bright white home. A nurse walks in, kneels between his legs, rubs his thighs and teases close to his shorts, talking softly the whole time. 2026-10-29: legs slowed - one slow action each, 'slowly' in every line, a steady camera in place of the handheld sway, and as few legs as the 6 s cap allows. The face blurred mid-gesture and drifted a little more at every handoff.

start.composition: a wide point-of-view photo from a man seated low on a sofa, his bare knees and thighs and his light grey shorts spread toward the camera at the bottom edge of the frame, she stands a few steps away facing the camera, her whole body in frame, smiling at him
start.outfit: a fitted white nurse mini dress with red trim and a zip front pulled down to show her cleavage
start.setting: bright airy daylight, in a white modern open-plan home with pale oak floors and a white kitchen behind her
start.negative: his face, a second man, extra legs, high angle

legs: she walks slowly toward the camera, smiling, and blows a soft kiss
she slowly kneels between his legs and rests her hands on his thighs, talking up at him
she slowly leans in close to his shorts with a playful closed-mouth smile, looking up into the camera
she sits back and slowly rubs her hands up and down his thighs
she slowly leans in again with a soft knowing smile, holding eye contact
leg_suffix: steady point of view from a man seated on a sofa, his knees and thighs fixed at the bottom of the frame, she moves slowly and gently, small smooth movements, continuous shot, no cuts
video_negative: camera cut, scene change, morphing, face change, extra fingers, distorted hands, flicker, different person, his face
script:
[1-6s] Hi. You look tense. Let me help with that.
[7-9s] Just relax for me.
[11-12s] Yes.
[12-14s] You feel better already.
[22-25s] I told you I'd take really good care of you.
